page: Amazon Web Services x8i.metal-96xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized instance engineered for enterprise workloads requiring extensive memory capacity and dedicated compute execution. Built on Intel x86_64 architecture, this bare-metal host provides 192 physical cores and 384 dedicated vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.9 GHz, supported by 6,144 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 16 GB of RAM per virtual processor core.

The server provides a baseline network throughput of 100 Gbps to support high-throughput data transfers between distributed systems and external storage volumes. Because the instance contains no bundled local storage, all persistent disk storage must be provisioned externally over the network. Additionally, the instance contains zero GPU accelerators, focusing all host resources entirely on CPU execution and memory capacity.

From an architectural efficiency standpoint, bare-metal deployment eliminates virtualization hypervisor overhead across the host's 384 processing threads. This high concentration of memory and compute resources provides efficient hardware utilization for scaling large monolithic environments. Primary workload fits include massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, large-scale caching tiers, memory-intensive data analytics, and enterprise transaction processing engines.
description: Amazon Web Services x8i.metal-96xl is a bare-metal, memory-optimized server designed for enterprise-scale in-memory computing. Powered by Intel x86_64 processors operating at 3.9 GHz, the server delivers 192 physical cores, 384 dedicated vCPUs, and 6,144 GB of memory, offering 16 GB of RAM per vCPU. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 100 Gbps, facilitating rapid throughput for network-intensive operations. The instance contains no integrated local storage or hardware GPU accelerators, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent disk input and output. By offering direct bare-metal hardware access without hypervisor overhead, x8i.metal-96xl delivers dense resource consolidation and strong efficiency for massive compute and memory footprints. It is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning platforms, big data analytics engines, and high-concurrency transactional workloads.
